_note: Fill in `inputs` using the unit in each _guide entry. Help text may quote SI units; the `unit` field is the one that applies. psig and psia are different: gauge arguments (set_g, back_g ...) are psig, absolute ones psia. Temperatures are readings, not differences.

out.help: CSV to write the statements to; must be outside version control or git-ignored

register.help: PHA register CSV to compare requirement types against

show.help: print this many statements to the screen (default 0: counts only)

allow_tracked.help: write even if the output path is inside a git repository and not ignored
